0022600139.text: The Timberwolves (3-1, 1-0 at home) are 6th in the West and 3rd in the Northwest, one game back, and they dropped their most recent game. The Warriors (1-3) are 12th in the West and 4th in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and they won their last game. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), and Yaxel Lendeborg is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. The Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, and the 2026-27 series has no games yet, with the teams last meeting on 2026-03-13 in San Francisco, a 127-117 Minnesota win.
